Name: Johnson,Alice
Passage: To be or not to be, that is the question: Whether 'tis nobler in the mind to suffer the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune, or to take arms against a sea of troubles.

Name: Smith,Bob
Passage: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness.

Name: Davis,Carol
Passage: All happy families are alike; each unhappy family is unhappy in its own way.
